title: Seven Stars - Everything Confirmed So Far (Phantom Blade Zero)
description: Seven Stars in Phantom Blade Zero - what has been confirmed about the encounter, its elemental weakness, rewards and how to approach it.

sections.title: Overview
sections.content: Seven Stars is a named boss from promotional material, described as a multi-phase encounter. Beyond the name and the phase structure, nothing has been shown in enough detail to describe the fight honestly.

Not confirmed pre-launch. S-GAME has not published elemental affinities for this encounter, and no demo footage shows one being exploited. Nothing here is estimated from the boss's appearance - that is exactly how wrong weakness tables get written before release.

sections.title: Rewards
sections.content: Not confirmed pre-launch. Bosses in Phantom Blade Zero are described by S-GAME as rewarding unique weapons on defeat, but no drop table has been published for this encounter, so none is listed here.

sections.title: How to Beat the Seven Stars
sections.content:
What has actually been shown

  • Named in official promotional material
  • Multi-phase design indicated
  • No extended gameplay footage released

Everything above comes from footage S-GAME released. Anything not listed has not been shown, however confident a write-up elsewhere looks.

How to approach it

There is no honest strategy section for an encounter nobody outside the studio has finished. What can be said comes from the systems rather than from the fight: blocking and heavy attacks both spend Sha-chi, so a defensive player who blocks everything runs out of the resource at the worst moment. Unblockable attacks have to be dodged, which means reading the animation rather than relying on the guard.

Real phase data, parry windows and timings land here once the game ships.

sections.title: Pre-launch Status
sections.content: This page tracks the Seven Stars in Phantom Blade Zero, which releases on October 29, 2026. It is written from official demo and trailer material only. After release it gets updated with verified fight data; see the boss guide for the full roster and the video guide index for walkthroughs.
